items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: one of the saxophone players was named Milligan, John Milligan... And they was working with a band.

ctx.x: In six months, and it was some colored fellow. He'd run the place, but I done forgot his name. But he paid off. Every night he paid off. And I said, don't tell us now to wait till Saturday. That was the little MG, man. I said, don't let me wait till Saturday. If you can't pay tonight, man, you can't pay it when it doubles up. So you drop it on us every night, six bucks. Old man, on drums, and this boy playing a lot of piano. But when I pick up, some gonna get right there with that rhythm, man. That's probably…
